primary_business_description.value: Item 1. Business Comcast Corporation (CMCSA) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Comcast operates cable communications (broadband, video, voice) and media businesses. Connectivity through the cable platform is a core economic engine. Principal operations: Comcast Corporation. Reported segments include: Connectivity & Platforms (58% of revenue); Content & Experiences (42% of revenue)
